title: Announcement September 11, 2026 Karman Space & Defense Completes Walker Acquisition, Establishing a Platform for Growth in European Defense Market
summary: Karman completed its acquisition of Walker Precision Engineering on August 28, 2026, strengthening Karman’s position in tactical missile and air defense subsystems and establishing a strong position in the European defense market.
body_markdown:
**ABOUT KARMAN SPACE & DEFENSE**


Karman Space & Defense is a leader in the rapid design, development and production of critical, next-generation system solutions that align with the U.S. Department of War’s core mission priorities and the nation’s accelerating demand for access to space. Building on nearly 50 years of success, we deliver Payload & Protection Systems, Hydro/Aerodynamic Interstage Systems, and Propulsion & Launch Systems to over 80 prime contractors supporting more than 130 space and defense programs. Karman is headquartered in Huntington Beach, Calif., with multiple facilities across the United States. For more information, visit our website,[www.karman-sd.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.karman-sd.com&esheet=54573403&newsitemid=20260720717950&lan=en-US&anchor=www.karman-sd.com&index=2&md5=a2387b40ae558d6de097c4416f5f3274)
